extraction_notes: Digitised SI catalytic-performance figures only. SI Figures S4 and S5 give CO2 conversion on the left axis and product selectivity on the right axis; SI Figure S6 gives methanol productivity; SI Figure S7 is a time-on-stream plot, so only the first and last plotted performance point for each catalyst panel was extracted. Carbon-balance curves in SI Figure S7 and non-performance/characterisation/computational figures were skipped. Pd1Zn15/TiO2 appears in the SI figures although it was not included in the supplied catalyst-name list; the paper’s own label was used.
